= =======================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SOURENDRA PANDEY  ORAL ORDER 2 03-02-2026 Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
2. The present application has been filed for quashing the order dated 02.08.2022 passed by S.D.J.M., Danapur, Patna in Complaint Case No. 426 of 2022, whereby cognizance has been taken against him under Section(s) 498A/34 of the I.P.C and under Section  of Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.88695 of 2024(2) dt.03-02-2026 petitioner no. 1 and 2 are the father-in-law and mother-in-law respectively,
of O.P. No. 2, while petitioner no. 3 is the dewar and petitioner nos. 4 and 5 are the married nanad of O.P. No. 2.

It has been submitted that vague and omnibus allegations have been levelled against the petitioners only in order to settle personal score and in fact, the petitioners have no concern with the differences between the O.P. No. 2 and her husband.

5. List this case on 10.03.2026 at 02:15 P.M., retaining its position.
6.
In the meantime, further proceedings in the concerned Court below with respect to the petitioner(s), in connection with the present case, shall remain stayed.

(Sourendra Pandey, J) aditya/-
